title: Hour of Devastation: card flavor text

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon planeswalker who remade Amonkhet, posed as the God-Pharaoh and created the Eternals; here he confronts the Gatewatch.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who speaks of those who run toward danger and is taunted by Bolas.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who wonders about Bolas's plan for the Eternals and whose illusions Liliana makes use of.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: Planeswalker who came to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound; Bolas threatens to take away her power.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch who uses fire against Bolas.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: Planeswalker of the Gatewatch tied to the soul of Amonkhet; she urges others to see that Bolas's power is not absolute.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: Group of planeswalkers whom Bolas addresses as his enemies on Amonkhet.

entities.name: Djeru
entities.description: Former Tah-crop initiate who lost faith in the God-Pharaoh after his lie was revealed.

entities.name: Samut
entities.description: Former Tah-crop initiate who fights through the hordes and urges survivors to flee the city and fight for tomorrow.

entities.name: Elekh
entities.description: Vizier of embalming who observes the mummies losing control.

entities.name: Neponem
entities.description: Vizier of Kefnet who recalls Kefnet's teaching.

entities.name: Etha
entities.description: Former Rhet-crop initiate who speaks of the Eternals as once being brothers and sisters.

entities.name: Khemses
entities.description: Charioteer who urges others forward.

entities.name: Sokar
entities.description: Former Nef-crop initiate who speaks of the ruin of the past as topsoil of the future.

entities.name: Sana
entities.description: Former Ahn-crop initiate.

entities.name: Arnun
entities.description: Vizier of the menagerie who tells people that Rhonas's monument belongs to the wurms now.

entities.name: Pytamun
entities.description: Former Nef-crop initiate.

entities.name: Amonkhet
entities.description: Desert plane remade by Nicol Bolas, whose city Naktamun falls in this set.

entities.name: Naktamun
entities.description: City of Amonkhet that is ruined as the hour of devastation arrives.

entities.name: Hekma
entities.description: Protective wall of Naktamun that was destroyed and breached.

entities.name: Luxa River
entities.description: River of Amonkhet that runs with blood.

entities.name: Broken Lands
entities.description: Region of Amonkhet whose crocodiles flooded into Naktamun.

entities.name: Eternals
entities.description: Undead warriors created from initiates who completed the trials, serving the God-Pharaoh.

entities.name: Oketra
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who did all for others to the end and died.

entities.name: Kefnet
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who in his final moments reached into the minds of those around him and died.

entities.name: Bontu
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who wanted to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects and died.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who fought until his last breath; his monument released his menagerie.

entities.name: Hazoret
entities.description: God of Amonkhet who favors creatures with great hearts.

entities.name: Razaketh, the Foulblooded
entities.description: One of the two remaining demons to whom Liliana is bound.

entities.name: Second Sun
entities.description: Celestial body on Amonkhet whose alignment preceded the sphinxes' warnings and heralded Bolas's return.

entities.name: Curse of Wandering
entities.description: Curse that permeated Amonkhet before Bolas; it ends when the last scrap of flesh is scoured away.

entities.name: Locust God
entities.description: God whose children eat away the city's protection.

entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: God whose sting sends venom strong enough to poison blood, bone and spirit.

events.summary: The gate to the afterlife opened and the people prostrated themselves in the light of the God-Pharaoh.
events.quote: the gate to the afterlife opened, and the people were prostrate in the light of the God-Pharaoh

events.summary: Bolas taunts Gideon Jura for playing the protector.
events.quote: how easy it must be to play the protector when you think yourself untouchable

events.summary: Bolas tells Jace he expected disappointment.
events.quote: I had hoped for more from you, Jace. But I expected as much.

events.summary: Bolas tells Liliana he can take away all the power she has gathered.
events.quote: All the power you have gathered for yourself, Liliana, I can take away.

events.summary: Bolas mocks Chandra's fire.
events.quote: Fire? Is that your only trick, Chandra?

events.summary: Bolas tells Nissa he would gladly kill the soul of the world again.
events.quote: The soul of this world is gone, Nissa, and I would gladly kill it again.

events.summary: Bolas declares to the Gatewatch that everything on Amonkhet exists or perishes at his whim.
events.quote: Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch.

events.summary: Bolas declares his work on Amonkhet complete.
events.quote: My work here is complete. The people have done everything required of them.

events.summary: Bolas declares the plane has outlived its usefulness.
events.quote: This place has outlived its usefulness.

events.summary: Jace wonders what Bolas's plan is for the Eternals.
events.quote: If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here, what is his plan for the Eternals?

events.summary: Jace warns that Bolas remade the plane in his image and holds the advantage.
events.quote: Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here.

events.summary: Djeru loses faith, declaring the God-Pharaoh lied.
events.quote: Samut was right. The God-Pharaoh lied.

events.summary: Samut urges Djeru to lead people out of the city.
events.quote: We have to get out of the city, Djeru.

events.summary: Samut battles through the hordes shouting the names of the dead and those she hopes to save.
events.quote: Samut battled her way through the hordes

events.summary: Samut rallies survivors to fight for tomorrow whether they believe the God-Pharaoh tested or betrayed them.
events.quote: If you believe he betrayed us all, join with me to fight for tomorrow!

events.summary: Buildings fell and the river ran with blood while servants kept working.
events.quote: The river bled and the sky wept tears of fire.

events.summary: Aven served as pathfinders, leading the last of the people from the ruins of Naktamun.
events.quote: swift-winged aven served as pathfinders, leading the last of the people away from the ruins of Naktamun

events.summary: Kefnet died, reaching into the minds of those around him in his final moments.
events.quote: In his final moments, Kefnet reached into the minds of those around him

events.summary: Kefnet's followers found only the gurgles of a dying god in his last words.
events.quote: they found only the gurgles of a dying god

events.summary: Bontu died wanting only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.
events.quote: To the last, Bontu wanted only to be first among the God-Pharaoh's subjects.

events.summary: Rhonas fought until his last breath and his monument fell, releasing his menagerie on the city.
events.quote: The destruction of Rhonas's monument released his collection upon the city.

events.summary: Oketra gave everything for others to the end.
events.quote: To the end, all Oketra did was for others.

events.summary: The Hekma was destroyed, letting the wandering dead into Naktamun.
events.quote: With the Hekma destroyed, the wandering dead that sought entrance to Naktamun had free rein to lay waste to the city.

events.summary: Liliana came to Amonkhet to confront a demon to whom she is bound.
events.quote: Liliana insisted on coming to Amonkhet to confront one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound.

events.summary: Bolas culled the plane of its adults before building Naktamun.
events.quote: Bolas culled the plane of its adults in order to rebuild it for his own designs.

events.summary: The God-Pharaoh was revealed to have built a factory to produce an army of Eternals.
events.quote: The God-Pharaoh's benevolence concealed the factory he created to produce an army of Eternals.

events.summary: The Second Sun reached its final position, heralding Bolas's return.
events.quote: As the Second Sun glided into its final position in the sky

events.summary: Angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches.
events.quote: The God-Pharaoh's angels stripped former initiates of their cartouches

events.summary: Nissa urges others to see that Bolas's power on the plane is not absolute.
events.quote: Bolas's power on this plane can't be absolute.

events.summary: Survivors ask what will happen to them and the vizier says it is up to them now.
events.quote: I think that's up to us now.

relations.note: Bolas addresses the Gatewatch as his foes.
relations.quote: Everything here exists or perishes at my whim. Including you, Gatewatch.
If creating the Eternals was Bolas's plan here

relations.note: Elekh is a vizier of embalming overseeing mummies.
relations.quote: It appears some mummies have begun to observe a hierarchy all their own.

relations.note: Neponem is the vizier of Kefnet.
relations.quote: Kefnet taught us to turn obstacles into advantages.

relations.note: Liliana is bound to this demon.
relations.quote: one of the two remaining demons to whom she is bound
Liliana always knew Jace's illusions would come in handy.
